tenderSchedule.title: MUDDENAHALLY ROUTE01
tenderSchedule.description:
INVITING A TENDER FOR PROVIDING A VEHICLE(MGV/MINIMUM 15 MT 
 CAPACITY) FOR TRANSPORTING AND DISTRIBUTING RAGI HEALTH MIX POWDER 
 OF KSHEERA BHAGYA SCHEME FROM MUDDENAHALLI, CHIKKABALLAPURA 
 DISTRICT TO CHANNARAYAPATTANA MILK CHILLING CENTER GODOWN TO AND AIDED SCHOOLS OF SOMAVARAPETE TALUK.
 THE BIDDER SHOULD QUOTE RATE PER KILOGRAM(KG) BASIS ONLY(THE QUOTE 
 RATE INCLUDES TRANSPORTING OF RAGI HEALTH MIX POWDER FROM 
 MUDDENAHALLI, CHIKKABALLAPURA DISTRICT TO CHANARAYAPATTANA MILK 
 CHILLING CENTER GODOWN, LOADING AND UNLOADING OF RAGI HEALTH MIX 
 POWDER AND TOLL FEE). APPROX 20 MT PER MONTH
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Hassan Co-operative Milk Producers Union Union Pvt (PI)

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
THE BIDDER SHOULD FOLLOW ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: THE BIDDER SHOULD FURNISH ALL TECHNICAL DOCUMENT AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT
